title: Universal Tap-to-Move & Rich Sound Engine
message: Play effortlessly with 1-click Tap-to-Move, legal move dots, capture rings, and zero-asset Web Audio featuring victory Checkmate fanfares & Stalemate chimes.

title: Maximized Mobile Chessboards & Smart Scroll
message: Maximized chessboard footprint across all mobile views (~95% screen width across Play Online, Computer, Puzzles, PGN, Blog), plus an adaptive bidirectional scroll button.

title: Live Move Sync & Non-Blocking Modals
message: Resolved WebRTC move desync with hybrid ACK protocol, replaced blocking dialogs with custom Draw/Resign modals, and fixed About page mobile layout.

title: Major Updates in About Section
message: Checkout Marwadi Chess about section and see major updates celebrating 4,500 years of chess heritage with dynamic Grandmaster quotes.

title: Stockfish AI Engine & Daily Tactics
message: Challenge 20 levels of Stockfish AI or solve daily tactical puzzles with move hints and streak counter.

title: Live Play Online Arena & Matchmaking
message: Play real-time multiplayer chess with digital clocks (3m, 5m, 10m, 30m), live lobby challenges, and PGN export.

title: My Games Dashboard & PGN Archive
message: Review your played games with move-by-move navigation, game statistics, and interactive PGN study library.

title: Interactive 2D Board Design & Dark Mode
message: Enjoy a modernized interactive 2D chessboard interface across all training pages with seamless Dark & Light theme modes.
